title: Revolutions, Lenin and the Birth of the Soviet State

walkthroughs.body_html: Wartime collapse (over 1.7 million Russian dead by 1917), the Tsarina's reliance on Rasputin (murdered December 1916) and bread riots in Petrograd (8-12 March) toppled Nicholas II. The Provisional Government under Lvov, then Kerensky, kept Russia in the war. Lenin's April Theses and the failed June Offensive shifted opinion. The Kornilov Affair (August) discredited Kerensky. On 25 October (OS) 1917, the Bolsheviks seized power.

The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk (3 March 1918) conceded vast territory to Germany. Trotsky built the Red Army (over 5 million strong by 1920). Whites under Kolchak, Denikin and Yudenich, plus Allied intervention, lacked unity. The Cheka (founded December 1917) conducted Red Terror. Famine in 1921-22 killed perhaps 5 million.

The Kronstadt Mutiny (March 1921) and peasant revolts forced the NEP. The same Tenth Congress banned factions. The USSR was constituted in December 1922. Lenin's Testament (December 1922-January 1923) criticised Stalin's rudeness. After strokes in 1922-23, Lenin died on 21 January 1924. A triumvirate of Zinoviev, Kamenev and Stalin sidelined Trotsky.

Versailles

mcqs.q: What was Lenin's slogan on returning to Russia in April 1917?
options: Peace, Land, Bread
Socialism in One Country
Workers of the World, Unite
All Power to the Duma

mcqs.q: What did Lenin's April Theses demand in 1917?
options: No support for the Provisional Government, all power to the Soviets, end the war, redistribute land — slogans summarised as 'Peace, Bread, Land'.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
The NEP was introduced by Stalin to fund the Five-Year Plans.
Lenin's April Theses called for an immediate alliance with the Provisional Government.

mcqs.q: Why did Lenin introduce the NEP in 1921?
options: The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
War Communism had collapsed the economy and provoked the Kronstadt revolt; the NEP allowed limited private trade to restore production and stabilise Bolshevik rule.
The NEP was introduced by Stalin to fund the Five-Year Plans.
The NEP was Lenin's plan to permanently switch Russia to capitalism.

mcqs.q: Why did the Provisional Government fail in 1917?
options: The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
The Provisional Government fell because the Tsar returned and reclaimed his throne.
It continued the unpopular war, did not redistribute land, shared 'dual power' with the Petrograd Soviet, and was discredited by the Kornilov affair before the Bolshevik takeover.
The Provisional Government fell because Lenin was personally more charismatic than Kerensky.
